title: Verify and State the Security Limits
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Verify and State the Security Limits.
learning_objectives: Explain verify and state the security limits using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for verify and state the security limits
Assess failure and operational limits of verify and state the security limits
concepts_covered: Tests cover internal policy and tooling paths; they do not prove that every secret is detected or that an entire CI runner is safe.
AuditLog.verify checks a local hash chain and plaintext scanning uses configured patterns; neither detects every compromise or plaintext secret.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
